title: pseudolysimachion longifolium subsp. pseudolongifolium
intro: Pseudolysimachion longifolium subsp. pseudolongifolium, commonly known as Alpine Pennyroyal, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pseudolysimachion longifolium subsp. pseudolongifolium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils containing compounds such as borneol, camphor, and limonene.
